biologicalHardStops: validated avian embryo and surrogate platform

limitations: PBDB occurrence records are literature-derived fossil evidence, not direct inspection of a specimen.
No morphology matrix, CT image, endogenous dinosaur DNA, species-level nuclear genome, viable cell or nucleus, embryo-surrogate platform, hatching, or de-extinction claim is provided.
Age midpoints are display summaries of preserved intervals and are never point estimates.
The fossil-candidate comparison preserves nulls and age intervals, accepts no caller score, and never emits scalar, ordinal, Pareto, revival, or biological-feasibility rankings.
Candidate ordinal preserves request order only; complete and truncated parent evidence both remain descriptive.
PBDB fossil-occurrence coverage is excluded from research-evidence completeness, gate decisions, and audit ordering and has a fixed biological-feasibility contribution of zero.
The feasibility audit accepts no caller-supplied scores and emits no biological-feasibility score or probability.
Actual biological revival and comparative proxy research are different objectives and cannot be compared on a shared feasibility scale.
Museum specimen enrichment should use current GBIF records; iDigBio is not a primary provider because its portal is frozen and retiring.
Comparative genomics and ancestral sequence reconstruction require separately sourced extant genomes and remain explicitly hypothetical for non-avian dinosaurs.
